report.text:
16 clips recorded. 1 thing that matters.

HIGH: Fight, in the dark at 6:22 AM. Birds fighting can injure each other; nobody was there to break it up.

Good news: Hen in the nest box, likely laying at 8:47 AM. No clip shows the egg, so Shepherd says likely.

Filtered: 9 noise clips
